description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for JFrog Platform relay logs, covering Artifactory request/access/traffic records, Access security-audit records, router request JSON, narrow Distribution request/access records, and narrowly evidenced Xray request/service/webhook records from public documentation/parser evidence.

normalized_fields.jfrog_component: Component such as artifactory, access, router, distribution, or xray
normalized_fields.jfrog_log_family: Derived family such as artifactory_request, artifactory_access, access_security_audit, router_request, distribution_request, distribution_access, or Xray family values
normalized_fields.trace_id: JFrog request/trace correlation identifier where present
normalized_fields.token_id: Synthetic or sanitized Access token identifier where present
normalized_fields.action: Raw HTTP method, Artifactory action_response, or Access event value depending on sourcetype
normalized_fields.vendor_raw_action: Raw JFrog action/event token preserved before any future analyst normalization
normalized_fields.signature: Repository path, entity name, or request URL grouping
normalized_fields.signature_id: Trace or token identifier used for fixture-backed correlation
normalized_fields.event: JFrog Access security-audit raw event token
normalized_fields.http_method: HTTP method from Artifactory/router request records
normalized_fields.traffic_direction: Artifactory traffic direction token such as DOWNLOAD or UPLOAD
normalized_fields.transfer_bytes: Artifactory traffic byte count for the repository path in the traffic log
normalized_fields.ordinal: Traffic log ordinal/sequence field where present
normalized_fields.xray_service: Xray service identifier such as jfxr or jfxana in Xray service logs
normalized_fields.severity: Xray service log severity token or webhook top severity alias where present
normalized_fields.watch_name: Xray watch name from webhook payload
normalized_fields.policy_name: Xray policy name from webhook payload
normalized_fields.policy_rule: Xray policy rule from webhook payload
normalized_fields.issues: Xray webhook issue array preserved as JSON/search-time context

supported_transports.label: TCP syslog / JFrog relay
supported_transports.notes: Dedicated TCP listener for one JFrog Platform record per line from file, Kubernetes sidecar, Fluent Bit, Cribl, or another relay.

supported_transports.label: TLS/RFC5425 syslog
supported_transports.notes: Preferred for production if the local SC4S deployment provisions TLS for this source.

source_log_version.name: JFrog Platform Artifactory/Access/router/Distribution/Xray log records
source_log_version.notes: Grounded in public integration/parser evidence and synthetic-equivalent fixtures, including JFrog-maintained Distribution request/access parser shapes; local JFrog version, SaaS/on-prem mode, collector wrapping, and multiline access/service behaviour must be validated before promotion.

validation.validated_by: Hermes curation only; no validated/verified status stated
validation.source_log_version: JFrog public parser/sample evidence and synthetic-equivalent fixtures only, including narrow Distribution request/access parser evidence
validation.evidence: Repository schema/fixture checks exercise synthetic-equivalent JFrog records only. Local replay preflight is blocked by missing SC4S listener/Splunk testbed; no live JFrog relay, SC4S replay, HEC delivery, or Splunk read-back captured.

explicit_gaps: No live JFrog Platform source-version emission, JFrog Cloud Log Collection, or SaaS/on-prem export replay/read-back.
No collector credential custody, API pagination/checkpoint, Kubernetes sidecar/file-tail, object-store archive decompression, or retry/deduplication proof.
No multiline Artifactory access/service log proof; fixtures are one record per line.
No Distribution lifecycle/business-event, Pipelines structured event, or complete JFrog Platform module coverage proof.
No production or field validation; synthetic-equivalent fixtures only.
e2e_docker_harness.evidence_boundary: Runnable disposable lab runbook only; success would prove fixture-route SC4S TEST -> Splunk TEST read-back for declared one-line JFrog relay shapes, not live JFrog source/collector validation or field validation.

test_event_sets.label: JFrog Platform synthetic-equivalent mixed records including Artifactory traffic, Distribution request/access, and Xray request/service/webhook rows

timestamp_policy.notes: Pipe-delimited request/access/security-audit, Distribution request/access, and Xray request fixtures start with UTC ISO-8601 timestamps; traffic fixtures use the public numeric timestamp shape; router JSON uses the UTC `time` field; Xray webhook JSON uses `created`.

field_delimiting.field_separator: pipe for Artifactory request, traffic, Access security-audit, Distribution request, and Xray request records; bracketed text for Artifactory access, Distribution access, and Xray service records; JSON object for router request and Xray webhook records
field_delimiting.quote_character: double quote in JSON records; none for pipe records
field_delimiting.escape_policy: JSON escaping for router records; local collector must preserve delimiters in pipe records
field_delimiting.notes: Each record includes one synthetic marker token for fixture validation only.

source.reference: docs/evidence/jfrog-platform-evidence-scan-20260608.md; public JFrog/Sumo Logic/Datadog/JFrog-maintained collector evidence for Artifactory request/access/traffic, Access security-audit, router request, narrow Distribution request/access, and narrow Xray request/service/webhook shapes.
source.notes: Fixtures use EXAMPLE users, synthetic trace/token IDs, example repository paths, and RFC5737 documentation IP ranges; no customer or tenant data.

curation.notes: Initial 2026-06-08 curation, 2026-06-18 Xray evidence-unblock hardening, and 2026-06-22 Distribution request/access hardening from official JFrog docs and JFrog-maintained parser evidence.

action.notes: Native JFrog method/action/event token; not normalized to a complete taxonomy.

status.notes: HTTP status or raw action outcome context.

bytes.notes: Traffic log byte count; not complete transfer accounting across all JFrog request/access families.

cim.notes: Partial Web, Change, Authentication/Audit, and software-supply-chain guidance only; not full Splunk TA parity.

resource.name.notes: Artifact repository path or Access entity.

metadata.uid.notes: Correlation identifier; token_id fixture value is synthetic.

finding.severity.notes: Xray webhook/service severity context; not complete OCSF finding taxonomy.

ocsf.notes: OCSF mapping is helper guidance only.

network.bytes.notes: Artifactory traffic byte count from traffic logs.

vulnerability.id.notes: Xray webhook issue identifiers where JSON search-time extraction exposes them.

ecs.notes: ECS mapping is partial and field-name guidance only.

pack_variants.label: Artifactory request/access/traffic relay
pack_variants.description: Artifactory request, access, and traffic records preserving trace, actor/source IP, method/action/direction, artifact path, status, sizes, byte count, duration, and user-agent where present.
known_limitations: No live JFrog relay replay/read-back captured.
Access logs may be multiline or line-wrapped in some deployments; fixture coverage is one-line only.

pack_variants.label: JFrog Access security-audit relay
pack_variants.description: Access security-audit records preserving synthetic/sanitized token, user, principal, entity, event type, event, and data-changed context.
known_limitations: Token/data_changed values are sensitive and must be sanitized in fixtures/evidence.

pack_variants.label: JFrog router request JSON relay
pack_variants.description: Router JSON request records preserving time, trace ID, remote address, method, URL, status, sizes, duration, and user agent.
known_limitations: No live router request replay/read-back captured.

pack_variants.label: JFrog Xray request/service/webhook relay
pack_variants.description: Narrow Xray coverage for generic JFrog request-log shape on /xray paths, Xray service-log records, and Xray webhook JSON policy/violation alerts from official JFrog documentation/KB evidence.
known_limitations: Xray request fixture is scoped to generic request-log records whose URL begins /xray/; it is not exhaustive Xray API coverage.
Xray webhook fixture is synthetic-equivalent from official payload-format docs, not live webhook delivery evidence.
JFrog Cloud Log Collection currently documents Artifactory/Audit support only; do not imply Cloud Log Collection exports Xray logs without local proof.

pack_variants.label: JFrog Distribution request/access relay
pack_variants.description: Narrow Distribution request/access log coverage preserving trace ID, actor/source IP, HTTP method, URL/status, action response, and repository path from JFrog-maintained parser-shaped records.
known_limitations: No live Distribution relay replay/read-back captured.
Covers request/access operational records only; release-bundle lifecycle/status/business-event semantics remain blocked without exact samples or schemas.
Content-length column naming differs between generic official request-log docs and one JFrog-maintained parser; preserve raw sizes and verify local field semantics before promotion.

pack_variants.label: Pipelines and Distribution business-event telemetry blocked
pack_variants.description: Distribution request/access source-shapes are implemented narrowly, but release-bundle lifecycle/status/business events and Pipelines build provenance remain blocked until exact public samples, official schemas, or sanitized examples are available.
known_limitations: Do not invent Distribution release-bundle status/activity fields without exact schema/sample evidence.
Do not invent Pipelines build provenance fields without exact schema/sample evidence.
Pipelines public evidence currently supports path/logger inventory only, source-shape fixture coverage notes.

cribl.notes: Use after sampling the local JFrog feed. Do not drop token/user/principal/entity, repository/artifact path, source IP, trace ID, status, user agent, raw action/event, or timestamp fields by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

validation_commands: Start Data Prepper with the generated pipelines.yaml in a disposable test container and confirm pipeline startup before replay/read-back.
data_prepper.notes: Data Prepper support is recorded as a conservative OpenSearch ingestion pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Data Prepper pipeline artifact is generated by this pack yet.

opensearch_dashboards.config_model: index pattern/data view -> saved objects NDJSON -> dashboard/visualizations
validation_commands: Import exported NDJSON into a disposable OpenSearch Dashboards space and confirm data view/index-pattern resolution.
opensearch_dashboards.notes: OpenSearch Dashboards support is recorded as visualization-target metadata only. Splunk dashboards, where present, have not been automatically translated to OpenSearch saved objects or live-tested.

known_limitations: No live JFrog relay, SC4S runtime replay, or Splunk read-back evidence; keep curated/unverified and do not promote to validated/verified.
Fixtures are synthetic-equivalent examples, not real JFrog deployment records.
Reduction candidates are opt-in and review-required; no default lossy drops are included.
Xray request/service/webhook coverage is narrow and synthetic-equivalent from public docs/KB/parser evidence; no live Xray webhook or log relay read-back has been captured.

Distribution request/access source-shapes are implemented narrowly from JFrog-maintained parser evidence; Distribution release-bundle business events and Pipelines structured parsing remain blocked until exact sample/schema evidence exists.

logging_presets.label: Basic JFrog Platform intake
logging_presets.description: Dedicated listener, parser, fixtures, and Splunk props for Artifactory, Access security-audit, router request, narrow Distribution request/access, and narrow Xray request/service/webhook families. Preserves events and fields.
logging_presets.notes: Safe default; no drops or field removal.

logging_presets.label: Standard JFrog Platform analyst knowledge
logging_presets.description: Adds eventtypes/tags for Artifactory request/access/traffic, Access security-audit, router request, Distribution request/access, and Xray request/service/webhook records. No drops or field removal.

logging_presets.label: Enhanced reviewed JFrog reduction candidates
logging_presets.description: Review-only candidate list for optional collector reduction. Not enabled by default; no SC4S reduction rule is shipped.

artifact_references.notes: Candidate fields/events require local readback validation before enablement.

logging_presets.notes: Use only after local sampling and approval.

source_delivery.notes: JFrog records typically come from file/API/export/Kubernetes sidecar or collector relay; SC4S does not own credentials/checkpoints.
source_delivery.validation_status: metadata_classification_only; does not imply live replay/read-back validation
